[SWS_CM_10308] Conditions for sending of a SOME/IP response message
⌈
The
sending of a SOME/IP response message shall be requested upon availability of
a result of the ara::core::Future, which either contains a valid value or an
ara::core::ErrorCode matching one of the possible ApApplicationErrors ref-
erenced by the ClientServerOperation in the role possibleApError of the ser-
vice method (see [SWS_CM_10306] and [SWS_CM_10307]) in case the Message
Type of the corresponding SOME/IP request message was set to REQUEST (0x00).
⌋
